## Message

```
[X18N4004] Plan is stale <detail>
├▶ fix: Files changed since the plan was made. Plan again.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n4004
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

A file changed after x18n made the plan, so x18n did not write anything. For `x18n extract --apply`, the source file changed after you wrote the plan file.

1. Run the command again. x18n makes a new plan from the current files.
2. For extraction, run `x18n extract --plan <file>` again and edit the new plan.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `4`.
